## How it was checked

- [ ] `uv run pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `scripts/check_release.sh` passes
- [ ] Numbers measured on a GPU name the GPU (and the region and date where they matter), with stock next to fast
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, `.env` or state files, or personal paths in the diff
- [ ] The docs (README, MODELS.md, the family's NOTES.md) say what is now true
